⚠️ Address Accuracy Notice

Please double-check your shipping address at checkout. Incorrect or incomplete addresses (missing apartment or suite numbers, wrong ZIP codes, etc.) may result in lost or delayed packages that cannot be refunded or replaced.

🔒 Age Verification Required

All vape orders must pass age verification before shipping. If AgeChecker cannot verify your age automatically, please email a clear photo of your government-issued ID along with your full name and order number to support@fogervapes.com. Our team will manually override the verification. Orders may be delayed or cancelled if verification is not completed.

$9 Flat Rate Shipping or Free Shipping on Orders Over $99

Due to high order volume, some orders are experiencing delays. Your order is our priority and will ship as quickly as possible. Thank you for your patience and continued support.
